title: Fractured Neck, Broken Collarbone, Relegation: Coppa Bernocchi Crash Takes Heavy Toll
content:
Raccagni could face surgery, Aranburu’s season is over, and Van den Berg loses third after a chaotic, crash-marred final 600 meters at Coppa Bernocchi. And that's not counting a delivery van that drove onto the course.

Read the full article at Fractured Neck, Broken Collarbone, Relegation: Coppa Bernocchi Crash Takes Heavy Toll on Velo.
